violations.text: Splash guard required between food prep sink and dishmachine. New Violation. Correct By: 06/05/2026

The following were observed in poor repair: -floors in kitchen (near fryer, under equipment and under 3 bay sink) -wallpaper leading to and in basement area -ceiling in basement restroom The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026
Several ceiling tiles in meat smoker prep room were observed in poor repair. Materials for ceiling tiles to be smooth, durable and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 06/05/2026

Staff restroom on the right side in basement is out of service. Restroom does not have a handsink. Ceiling was also observed in poor repair. Restroom was taken out of service during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/05/2026
Splash guard required between food prep sink, dish machine drainboard and 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 06/05/2026

The cutting block on the prep unit is very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/05/2026
The caulking at the handsink near dishmachine is in poor repair (causing black residue accumulation). New Violation. Correct By: 05/05/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the shelving in the walk-in cooler and various refrigeration units have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
Water not available at mop sink in kitchen. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The condensate from laundry machine is draining into the toilet in left side staff restroom in basement. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain or other approved method. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
